episode.title: Halt repeated variants of read-only repository inspection commands
episode.before: At parent 680f523853175856236162460fcd6985c9d68620, always-on loop protection recognized only consecutive tool calls with identical names and arguments plus the per-turn tool-call cap. Repeated shell inspection calls whose command strings varied could therefore avoid the identical-call guard; the broader same-tool action-stagnation heuristic was behind the skipLoopDetection gate. No shell-inspection loop type, normalized inspection bucket, streak state, or corresponding diagnostic existed.
episode.after: At 3ce46949c2132dd8b3cc8f05cdc6c023aee0c2da, the always-on safety tier classifies read-only overview-style repository inspections into one semantic bucket, counts consecutive bucket membership, and halts at eight calls with a dedicated loop type and telemetry event. The streak resets on any nonmatching tool call and on retry, and honors the explicit session-level disable. Classification fails open for write-bearing or non-repository command chains and file-specific diffs. Existing stream handling then clears pending calls, emits LoopDetected, and stops the turn; the non-interactive CLI reports the dedicated reason and identifies it as always-on.
episode.diff: The commit modifies five files: it adds shell-inspection classification, streak tracking, reset behavior, threshold detection, loop logging, and always-on wiring in the loop-detection service; adds the SHELL_COMMAND_STAGNATION telemetry enum; extends the non-interactive reason map and always-on hint; updates client comments describing the safety tier; and adds regression coverage for varied and newline-separated inspections, threshold behavior, resets, session disable, and false-positive boundaries for productive chains, non-repository commands, and path-specific diffs.

evidence_units.claim: Commit 3ce46949c2132dd8b3cc8f05cdc6c023aee0c2da resolves the linked issue through PR #5944 and has parent 680f523853175856236162460fcd6985c9d68620; it changes five implementation and test files.
evidence_units.source: issue-bundle.json linked_pull_requests[0], resolved_commit, parent_commit, and commit_show_stat; git show --stat 3ce46949c2132dd8b3cc8f05cdc6c023aee0c2da

evidence_units.claim: The parent always-on safety method enforced consecutive identical tool-call detection and the per-turn cap, but had no semantic shell-inspection detector; broader action stagnation was processed only in the separately gated heuristic tier.
The change adds an eight-call shell-inspection threshold, a normalized inspection key, consecutive streak state, and detection that records SHELL_COMMAND_STAGNATION and logs a LoopDetectedEvent.

A shell call is placed in the stagnation bucket only when every command-chain segment is a git status, overview diff, or ls-files inspection. Empty chains, mixed commands, write-bearing chains, and file-specific diffs fail open as non-inspection activity.
evidence_units.source: git show 3ce46949c2132dd8b3cc8f05cdc6c023aee0c2da:packages/core/src/services/loopDetectionService.ts, getShellInspectionKey, isGitOverviewInspectionCommand, isOverviewGitDiff, and isGitRevisionToken

evidence_units.claim: A nonmatching tool call clears the shell-inspection key and streak; retry invokes resetToolCallCount, which also clears this state; an explicit session disable bypasses shell-stagnation detection.
evidence_units.source: git show 3ce46949c2132dd8b3cc8f05cdc6c023aee0c2da:packages/core/src/services/loopDetectionService.ts, checkShellCommandStagnation, checkAlwaysOnSafeties Retry branch, and resetToolCallCount

evidence_units.claim: Production stream processing invokes checkAlwaysOnSafeties before the skipLoopDetection gate. When it fires, pending tool calls are cleared, a typed LoopDetected event is yielded, and the turn returns early.
evidence_units.source: git show 3ce46949c2132dd8b3cc8f05cdc6c023aee0c2da:packages/core/src/core/client.ts, resultStream event loop around checkAlwaysOnSafeties

evidence_units.claim: The telemetry contract gains SHELL_COMMAND_STAGNATION with serialized value shell_command_stagnation, and the non-interactive CLI maps it to a human-readable explanation and always-on configuration hint.
A regression test feeds eight distinct overview inspection variants, verifies no halt for the first seven, then verifies a halt, the dedicated loop type, and matching telemetry on the eighth.
evidence_units.source: git show 3ce46949c2132dd8b3cc8f05cdc6c023aee0c2da:packages/core/src/services/loopDetectionService.test.ts, test 'halts repeated git inspection command variants via the always-on guard'

evidence_units.claim: Regression tests prove that a non-inspection tool call and a Retry event reset an accumulated seven-call inspection streak, and that an explicit session disable suppresses this guard.
evidence_units.source: git show 3ce46949c2132dd8b3cc8f05cdc6c023aee0c2da:packages/core/src/services/loopDetectionService.test.ts, shell-stagnation reset and disable tests

evidence_units.claim: Boundary tests verify that write-bearing chains, chains containing non-git commands, repeated non-git commands, and path-specific diffs do not enter the stagnation bucket, while newline-separated overview inspections do halt at the threshold.
evidence_units.source: git show 3ce46949c2132dd8b3cc8f05cdc6c023aee0c2da:packages/core/src/services/loopDetectionService.test.ts, shell command stagnation boundary tests

evidence_units.claim: The commit message documents the false-positive correction: every chain segment must be read-only inspection, mixed write chains fail open, and path-specific diffs are treated as progress.

The added test suite supplies positive, reset, disable, and negative-boundary oracles for the new contract; runtime execution was not performed because the provided checkout worktree has its tracked contents deleted, so validation here is source-established rather than independently executed.

candidate_atomics.name: classify-read-only-inspection-variants
candidate_atomics.description: Normalize syntactically different, overview-style read-only inspection commands into one semantic category while excluding operations that demonstrate progress.

semantic_action.intent: Recognize repeated inspection behavior even when command arguments or chaining syntax vary, without classifying productive shell work as stagnation.
semantic_action.pre_state: A shell tool request contains an arbitrary command string that may combine multiple command segments.
semantic_action.post_state: The request either maps to a stable read-only overview-inspection key when every segment satisfies the contract, or maps to no key when any segment writes, invokes another command family, or performs a path-specific diff.
semantic_action.validation: Positive tests cover varied and newline-separated overview inspections; negative tests cover mixed write chains, non-git commands, and file-specific diffs.

candidate_atomics.name: guard-consecutive-semantic-stagnation
candidate_atomics.description: Count consecutive calls in the normalized inspection category, reset the count on progress or replay boundaries, and halt at a bounded threshold.

semantic_action.intent: Stop a turn that repeatedly performs equivalent read-only inspections despite varying the exact command text.
semantic_action.pre_state: Tool-call events arrive sequentially and may repeatedly resolve to the same semantic inspection category without intervening progress.
semantic_action.post_state: Eight consecutive matching inspections set the dedicated loop state and emit telemetry; a nonmatching call or retry resets the streak, and a session-level disable suppresses the guard.
semantic_action.validation: Threshold tests prove the eighth varied inspection fires; reset tests prove intervening progress and retry prevent carry-over; the disable test proves the explicit session override is honored.

candidate_atomics.name: propagate-typed-loop-termination
candidate_atomics.description: Carry the new detector result through telemetry, stream termination, pending-call cleanup, and user-facing diagnostics.

semantic_action.intent: Make a detected semantic stagnation event terminate execution cleanly and explain why the run stopped.
semantic_action.pre_state: The always-on detector has marked the current event as a shell-command stagnation loop.
semantic_action.post_state: Pending tool calls are discarded, a typed loop event is emitted, execution returns early, telemetry identifies the new loop type, and non-interactive output describes the reason and always-on status.
semantic_action.validation: The service test asserts the dedicated loop type and telemetry payload; call-site inspection establishes existing early-return handling for any always-on detector result.

candidate_workflows.name: add-a-semantic-circuit-breaker-for-variant-tool-calls
candidate_workflows.description: Establish a narrow semantic equivalence contract for repeated tool calls, enforce it as a bounded stateful guard, then propagate and validate the typed termination while protecting legitimate progress paths.

workflow_graph.goal: Halt repeated semantically equivalent inspection calls that evade exact-argument duplicate detection without stopping productive shell activity.
workflow_graph.entry_state: An execution loop has exact-call and total-call safeguards, but varied arguments let equivalent read-only inspection calls continue; broader stagnation heuristics may be configuration-gated.
workflow_graph.exit_state: A narrowly classified semantic category is guarded at a tested threshold in the always-on tier, resets at progress and retry boundaries, fails open for ambiguous or productive commands, and produces typed termination telemetry and diagnostics.
